 Order

The petitioner seeks for a Writ of Mandamus, to forbear the Respondents 2 and 3 or their men in any manner interfering with the petitioners right for feeding of stray dogs in Pudukkottai in the light of the circular issued by the Animal Welfare Board of India, dated 26.02.2015, relating to feeding of stray dogs.
2.The petitioner claims that she is running a trust indulging in social service.
One amongst it being feeding stray dogs and other animals in Pudukottai.
She states that she is following the circulars of the Animal Welfare Board of India at the time of feeding.
She further states that whenever a stray dog is injured, she immediately attends to the dog by giving it appropriate treatment.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis

3.She states that on 24.07.2023, while she was feeding stray dogs, certain persons attacked her violently resulting in a complaint being registered in Cr.No.233 of 2023 on the file of the Inspector of Police, Ganeshnagar Police Station, Pudukottai District.
She claims that under Article 51A of Constitution of India, it is her duty to take care of stray animals and that she is merely fulfilling this duty.
This is being objected by the respondents as well as by private parties.
She states that she gave a representation to the respondents on 08.01.2025 and as there was no effective response to the same, she has come forward with the present Writ Petition.

4.When the matter came up for admission, Mr.G.Suryananth, learned Additional Government Pleader took notice for the respondents No.1 and 2, Mr.K.R.Kishore Ram took notice for the third respondent and Mr.M.Karunanithi, learned Government Advocate, took notice for the respondents No.4 and 5.

5.I pointed out to, the petitioner as well as to Mr.K.R.Kishore Ram, that the Union of India has come out with the Animal Birth Control Rules, 2023 and that these Rules are statutory in nature.

9.Mr.R.Balasubramanian states that the petitioner is agreeable to abide by the conditions imposed by the Pudukottai Corporation.

In addition, he states that he will comply with the guidelines, that have been given by the Bruhath Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike, dated 22.07.2024, for community feeders for stray animals in Bengaluru.

The guidelines are extracted hereunder:
1.Please take up feeding animals only if you are able to maintain continuity.
Gaps in feeding can make dogs and cats restless & at times aggressive.
2.Please take up feeding if you are financially sound to maintain continuity on your own.

Kavitha vs The District Collector on 27 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/118494900/
4 3.Please take up feeding only if you can personally oversee the feeding activity to maintain accountability in case of issues.
4. Please take up feeding if you can provide one full healthy meal per animal per day.

sentences.text: 5.Avoid alternate day feeding in places where there is no food source for animals.
6.Always keep a document about animal laws handy.
7.Do not go inside anybody's property to feed without permission.
8.Know your rights, and invest in a bodycam for your own safety.
Keep your mobile with you always.
9.Avoid feeding community animals in extreme timings i.e. after 11:30PM or before 5AM unless there is a beat police around to provide protection in your area.
10.Avoid venturing alone to feed in places that are isolated.
11.Avoid feeding community animals; raw meat, biscuits with high sugar content as this makes the dogs hyperactive.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis
12.If possible, please use reusable plates and clean the place post feeding rounds.
13.Avoid leaving the leftover food on the curb side as this can create rodent issues in societies.
14.If you are feeding community animals of your society then please get feeding spots assigned with the help of association president and BBMP and feeding in assigned spots only.

15.Avoid feeding community animals in front of anybody's house, entrance or exit of a society,
basement parking area, children's play area and in common areas frequented by public.

[a]
16.Avoid feeding at a time when public density is high as dogs tend to get protective about their food.
17.Feed dogs in their own territory, do not bundle them in one single place & feed.
18.Avoid getting into altercations and opt for peaceful mediation with residents.
Take help of BBMP zonal AD in case of situations that can wait till next day.
Take help of police only in extreme situations.
